variableDeclarations.name: current_playbook
variableDeclarations.description: Playbook the agent currently has open.

variableDeclarations.name: current_task
variableDeclarations.description: Task the agent currently has loaded inside the open playbook.

variableDeclarations.name: next_agent_actions
variableDeclarations.description: Reply and actions queued by a tool through set_next_agent_actions, played by the before-model callback without calling the model.

variableDeclarations.name: played_greeting
variableDeclarations.description: Whether the greeting was already sent.

variableDeclarations.name: pending_handoff_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Reason code set by a tool when the conversation must be handed off to a live representative.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_summary
variableDeclarations.description: Summary of the conversation for the representative, set by execute_live_agent_handover.

variableDeclarations.name: order_id
variableDeclarations.description: Order number of the order that was last looked up.

variableDeclarations.name: order_status
variableDeclarations.description: Status of the order that was last looked up (Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Canceled, Return Started, Return Pickup Scheduled).

variableDeclarations.name: order_item
variableDeclarations.description: Item name for the order that was last looked up.

variableDeclarations.name: order_delivery
variableDeclarations.description: Estimated or actual delivery of the order that was last looked up.

variableDeclarations.name: on_file_zip
variableDeclarations.description: Shipping ZIP code stored on the looked-up order, checked by verify_order_zip and never shown in the prompt before verification.

variableDeclarations.name: zip_verified
variableDeclarations.description: Whether the customer verified the shipping ZIP code for the current order.

variableDeclarations.name: zip_attempts
variableDeclarations.description: Number of non-matching ZIP code attempts in the conversation, across all orders.

variableDeclarations.name: sms_disclosure_played
variableDeclarations.description: Order number for which the text message terms were shared with the customer.

variableDeclarations.name: sms_summary_sent
variableDeclarations.description: Order number for which the order summary text was sent.

variableDeclarations.name: return_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Validated return reason for a return pickup (damaged, wrong_item, changed_mind, other).

variableDeclarations.name: return_availability_checked
variableDeclarations.description: Whether pickup days and windows have been checked for the current order.

variableDeclarations.name: return_pickup_day
variableDeclarations.description: Selected pickup day for a return pickup.

variableDeclarations.name: return_pickup_window
variableDeclarations.description: Selected time window for a return pickup (morning or afternoon).

variableDeclarations.name: return_contact_phone
variableDeclarations.description: Validated 10-digit callback phone number for a return pickup.

variableDeclarations.name: return_summary_confirmed
variableDeclarations.description: Whether the customer confirmed the pre-booking return pickup summary.

variableDeclarations.name: return_pickup_completed
variableDeclarations.description: Whether the return pickup booking has been submitted for the current order.

variableDeclarations.name: return_confirmation_id
variableDeclarations.description: Confirmation ID returned when a return pickup is booked.
